description: This file defines a Java interface called StatusChangeListener, which declares methods related to different status change events in an ECU logging UI context, such as connecting, reading data, logging data, and stopping.

classes.name: StatusChangeListener
classes.description: An interface that specifies callback methods for various ECU status change events in the logging UI.

methods.name: connecting
methods.description: Triggered when the status indicates a connection is being established.

methods.name: readingData
methods.description: Triggered when data reading process starts or is ongoing.

methods.name: loggingData
methods.description: Triggered when data logging is active.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Triggered when the status indicates that the process has stopped.
